description: This is a PHP source file for a web-based configuration wizard that manages Wi-Fi settings, including network names, security modes, and passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands. It includes server-side logic, embedded HTML, and JavaScript for form handling and validation.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends configuration data via AJAX to persist Wi-Fi settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, serializes it into JSON, and invokes set_config to save settings.
